defects.title: Mobile bottom navigation bar missing on /board route
evidence: S-004 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > div > header · <header> "Board Room" · x=0 y=0 width=375 height=56
S-004 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > div > main · <main> "CEO request Professor Optimus " · x=0 y=56 width=375 height=724.55
defects.expected: Locked decision A1 specifies: 'Header on top; conversation/board in the main area; on mobile a bottom navigation bar.' The bottom navigation bar must be persistently present on mobile viewports (375x667) across all primary screens, including the Board Room.
defects.actual: On route /board at 375x667 (S-004), no bottom navigation bar (`body > nav`) is present in the DOM or viewport. The user cannot navigate back to Overview, Agents, or Reports from the board screen.

defects.title: Low text contrast on inactive mobile bottom navigation items
evidence: S-001 dom: body > nav > a:nth-of-type(2) · <a> "Board" · x=102.25 y=594 width=85.25 height=60 · fontSize=10.5px fontWeight=500 fontFamily=GeistSans · color=rgb(86, 92, 108) backgroundColor=rgb(11, 12, 17) contrastRatio=2.92 LOW-CONTRAST · touch 85.25x60

S-001 dom: body > nav > a:nth-of-type(3) · <a> "Agents" · x=187.5 y=594 width=85.25 height=60 · fontSize=10.5px fontWeight=500 fontFamily=GeistSans · color=rgb(86, 92, 108) backgroundColor=rgb(11, 12, 17) contrastRatio=2.92 LOW-CONTRAST · touch 85.25x60

S-001 dom: body > nav > a:nth-of-type(4) · <a> "Reports" · x=272.75 y=594 width=85.25 height=60 · fontSize=10.5px fontWeight=500 fontFamily=GeistSans · color=rgb(86, 92, 108) backgroundColor=rgb(11, 12, 17) contrastRatio=2.92 LOW-CONTRAST · touch 85.25x60

S-002 dom: body > nav > a:nth-of-type(2) · <a> "Board" · x=200.5 y=951 width=183.5 height=60 · fontSize=10.5px fontWeight=500 fontFamily=GeistSans · color=rgb(86, 92, 108) backgroundColor=rgb(11, 12, 17) contrastRatio=2.92 LOW-CONTRAST · touch 183.5x60
defects.expected: Locked decision A1 specifies: 'Text contrast ≥4.5:1 (WCAG AA).'
defects.actual: Inactive navigation items ('Board', 'Agents', 'Reports') in the mobile navigation bar use color rgb(86, 92, 108) on rgb(11, 12, 17) background, resulting in a contrast ratio of only 2.92:1, failing WCAG AA requirements.

defects.expected: Locked decision A1 specifies: 'Every interactive control ≥44×44 px.' Check check:T23-touch-mobile requires all buttons and links to be at least 44×44px.
defects.actual: Key interactive controls fail the 44px threshold: header menu toggle buttons measure 36×36px, primary CTA 'Convene board' buttons measure 142×36px (height 36px), and secondary action 'Open' measures 61×26.5px (height 26.5px).

defects.title: Mobile bottom navigation bar is completely missing on /board route
evidence: check:T23-live
defects.expected: Locked decision A1 requires: 'Header on top; conversation/board in the main area; on mobile a bottom navigation bar.' The bottom navigation bar must persist across primary mobile routes including /board.
defects.actual: On route /board at 375x667 (S-004), there is no bottom navigation bar in the DOM (body > nav is missing), trapping mobile users on the board view with no tab access back to Overview, Agents, or Reports.

defects.title: Interactive buttons and link controls violate minimum 44x44px touch target size
evidence: S-001 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > div > header > button height=36
S-001 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > div > main > div > div:nth-of-type(1) > section:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > div > div > button height=36
S-001 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > div > main > div > div:nth-of-type(1) > section:nth-of-type(5) > div > button height=26.5
check:T23-touch-mobile
defects.expected: Locked decision A1 requires: 'Every interactive control ≥44×44 px.'
defects.actual: check:T23-touch-mobile fails with 3 buttons too small on mobile. Header menu button is 36x36px, 'Convene board' button is 142x36px (height 36px < 44px), 'Open' button is 61x26.5px (height 26.5px < 44px), and additional anchor buttons such as 'All' (52x27.25px), 'Read' (70x32px), and 'All sessions' (118x36px) fail the 44px height threshold.
